// A portion of an axis-rotated ellipse. Radii holds the semi-axis lengths along
// the ellipse's local X and Y; Rotation tilts the major frame from the +X axis;
// Angles sweeps the parametric angle (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ellipse).
type EllipticalArc2D
    implements ICurve2D
{
    Center: Point2D;
    Radii: Number2;
    Rotation: Angle;
    Angles: AngleInterval;
}
